title: feat(ui): shared account identity, app user menu, and wallet status
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Avatars link to the dashboard everywhere: on Enter's authorize, edit-key, and top-up headers and inside the app user menu, where the name and chevron open the menu. Menus without a destination keep the whole pill as the trigger.
- App sign-in button reads "Pollinations Connect": amber cell with the Pollinations mark, light label cell, amber border. One style only; the `triggerVariant` prop is removed.
- App user menu: Permissions, Buy Pollen, Disconnect. Quests shortcut, `onTopUpKey`, and the old label keys are removed. After following Permissions or Buy Pollen, the menu re-reads the key and wallet when the app regains focus, so the pill reflects the change without a reload.
- Second line of the pill: a budgeted key shows its own budget ("3.25 pollen") or a red Limit reached badge; an unlimited key shows the account's quest and paid balances when the key has the usage scope, otherwise a blue Unlimited badge.
- Enter's authorize, edit-key, and top-up headers show quest and paid balances, or a red No Pollen · Top up badge when the wallet is empty (no link on the top-up page itself). The authorize screen's separate out-of-Pollen alert is removed; the header carries it.
- Account names use the display name, then the GitHub handle, everywhere.
- Account menus size to the pill and their content; the balance line never truncates.
- `/account/key` returns the key's opaque `id`; SDK `KeyInfo.id` added.
- New shared `AccountPollen` in `@pollinations/ui/wallet`; new `PowerIcon`.
- Not included: paid-only signalling on the authorize screen and the connection error/hydrating states (later PRs).

gist.headline: Your key has a pulse
gist.blurb: Account identity and wallet status now travel together across Connect, Enter, and the dashboard. Polli has placed the pollen meter somewhere you can actually see it.
gist.summary: Unified account identity and wallet UI across Enter and app menus, adding dashboard-linked avatars, display-name-first labels, live key/account pollen status, and the key’s opaque id in `/account/key` and `KeyInfo.id`.
gist.impact: Users can see a key’s 3.25-pollen budget or Limit reached state, or quest and paid balances for unlimited usage-scoped keys, then refresh those details after Permissions or Buy Pollen without reloading the app.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy shared account-status pill becomes a little garden dashboard: Polli, wearing a tiny accountant visor, checks a glowing pollen jar beside a dashboard-linked avatar card while a friendly CRT robot holds a key marked with an opaque ID. Small code-plants and balance badges show a healthy budget, an Unlimited badge, and a carefully tended pollen supply.
